authority: User instruction: no hard cell-count or memory-MB acceptance caps; retain lossless performance improvements and prioritize working correct workflows.

required: Preserve literal values, formulas, types, source revisions and unrelated content.
Reject unsupported semantic mutations explicitly before publication.
Preserve drafts, cancellation, atomic batches and durable recovery.
Record exact source/build/fixture identity and observed test outcomes.

workloads.selection: Use representative authorized files and documented synthetic regression fixtures. Fixture sizes describe measurements, not product limits.

currentSuppliedSample.equivalence: Not equivalent: independent streaming inventory found128126 typed cell mismatches already present in the originals. Preserve each original separately; do not normalize text encoding.
currentSuppliedSample.qualification: Source-level read/edit/save and first-formula evidence is separate from final current-package and live-agent acceptance. No fixture size is a product limit.

required: sample counts, cold/warm conditions and machine/runtime/source/build identity
memory measurement method, samples and sampling errors
functional results, preserved package/content and source identity
observations.unavailable: Record missing measurements as unavailable with a reason. Functional acceptance and measurement completeness are separate; unavailable diagnostics are never reported as measured or as performance passes.
observations.comparison: Compare like workloads and runtime conditions. A high measurement alone does not reject a correct completed workflow.

preserve: Cancellation and finite test deadlines for hung work.
Bounded MCP responses with explicit pagination/truncation.
Input integrity, authorization, atomic publication and resource cleanup.
safeguards.qualification: Operational safeguards do not establish product cell/RSS/latency limits and must not silently omit content or disable otherwise qualified features.
